C3 says article published in 2022 (vol 7 issue 3 pp 110-114). Need establish six years after publishing book. From Nov 15 2016 to 2022? Six years after publishing book would be 2022? Also "on a similar topic": C3 title includes Vipassana meditation and mathematical overlaps; book Vipassana and Mathematics. Similar topic likely. But candidate locator specifically "six years after publishing the book". Need exact temporal relation. Claims do not establish article was published six years after book; only same year as six-year anniversary? Actually 2016 + 6 = 2022. Many would treat as six years after in year terms. But parent says then published article six years after publishing the book. If book published 2016, article in 2022, yes? Need consider "six years after" could mean in 2022. Since C1 gives exact date, C3 gives year only. To prove "six years after publishing the book", if publication in 2022 could be before Nov 15, then not six years after. Is that a semantic condition? Yes temporal precision. Need decide. Maybe if article "published in 2022" and book "November 15, 2016", it is not guaranteed six years after. Could be 5 years 1 month. Missing exact publication date. Therefore NOT_SUBTRACTABLE.

Need provide missing_or_unsupported. We should be brief. Mention exact publication date of article (or evidence it occurred after Nov 15 2022 / six years after book) not established. Claim C3 only 2022. Also maybe similar topic? But most important missing is exact temporal interval. Return JSON.
